Name: Greenscreen
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
Simple mod that adds a greenscreen (+ blue, black, and whitescreen) location for content creators (and anyone else) to use.


[size=5][b][u]How to Get There
[/u][/b][/size]Simply type this command:﻿[code]debug warp Custom_Greenscreen 20 20
[/code]into your SMAPI console, and enjoy!

For blue, black and whitescreen location, the command remains the same, but replace the [code]﻿Green
[/code]with the respective colour. e.g:
[code]﻿debug warp Custom_Bluescreen 20 20
[/code]for the bluescreen map.
